# SmartCVDsign — Copilot Cloud Agent Instructions

## Architecture (high level)
- Frontend: React + Vite (`src/`), DI services via `src/providers/ServicesProvider.jsx`.
- Backend/data/agents/workflows: Base44 config under `base44/`.
- Core product flow: **Suitable Jobs / CV Builder / CV Tools** as one connected workspace (not isolated tools).
- Routing and app shell: `src/App.jsx`.

## Key files and responsibilities
- `src/App.jsx`: routes, protected pages, legacy redirects.
- `src/pages/Builder.jsx`: main CV editing/workflow orchestration.
- `src/services/cv/service.js`: SavedCV repository access.
- `src/lib/workflowRoutes.js`: workflow decision (general review vs job tailoring).
- `src/lib/cvProfiles.js`: master/tailored CV model and create-only tailored payload.
- `src/lib/tailoringSession.js`: base CV resolution for tailoring sessions.
- `src/lib/cvSaveTarget.js`: save target rule (`update` current CV id, else `create`).
- `src/components/cv/CVRelationBar.jsx`: read-only parent/children navigation between CV versions.
- `src/lib/repositioning/useCareerRepositioning.js`: trigger/orchestration for repositioning analysis.
- `src/lib/repositioning/contract.js`: parsing/validation/fingerprint contract for repositioning results.
- `src/lib/repositioning/session.js`: agent conversation/input transport for repositioning runs.
- `src/pages/CareerPaths.jsx`: read-only rendering of repositioning result + manual retrigger.
- `base44/entities/*.jsonc`: persistence schema + RLS.
- `base44/agents/career_repositioning_agent.jsonc`: repositioning agent contract and read-only scope.

## Protected files / areas (high risk — do not change without explicit request)
- `base44/entities/SavedCV.jsonc`
- `base44/entities/RepositioningAnalysis.jsonc`
- `base44/entities/JobApplication.jsonc`
- `base44/entities/Notification.jsonc`
- `base44/agents/career_repositioning_agent.jsonc`
- `base44/agents/application_tailor.jsonc`
- `base44/workflows/*.jsonc`
- `src/lib/cvProfiles.js`, `src/lib/tailoringSession.js`, `src/lib/cvSaveTarget.js`
- `src/services/jobs/service.js`, `src/services/llm/service.js`

## CV Master / Tailored / Draft + versioning logic
- Canonical types in code: `master` and `tailored` (`src/lib/cvProfiles.js`).
- Legacy rows without `cvType` are treated as `master` by inference.
- Tailored CV creation is **create-only** from base CV; never mutate base CV during tailoring.
- Tailored linkage fields used in app logic: `parentCvId`, `sourceMasterCvId`, `jobApplicationId`.
- Base selection for tailoring:
  - explicit selected master,
  - selected tailored reused only when job similarity passes threshold,
  - otherwise fallback to original master,
  - otherwise local Fast Matching ranking.
- Save behavior is strict: current CV id => update same row; no id => create new row (`resolveSaveTarget`).
- Draft behavior in current architecture is workflow state (review/tailor sessions), not a separate persisted `cvType`.

## Repositioning architecture
- Trigger/orchestrator: `useCareerRepositioning` (Builder + CareerPaths manual trigger).
- Input window: latest up to 20 SavedCV versions (analyze all when <20; cap at 20 when >20).
- Idempotency/concurrency: fingerprint (`repositioningFingerprint`) + running/ready checks in `RepositioningAnalysis`.
- Agent session transport: `src/lib/repositioning/session.js` (`createConversation`, `addMessage`, polling/subscription).
- Contract parser is fail-closed (`parseRepositioningResult`): only valid structured blocks are accepted.
- Result persistence: `RepositioningAnalysis.result`; notification created only for useful results.
- UI consumption is read-only in `CareerPaths`.

## ProfessionalProfile architecture
- Professional profile is generated by `career_repositioning_agent` and embedded under `result.professionalProfile`.
- Accepted only through contract validation in `src/lib/repositioning/contract.js`.
- Persisted in `RepositioningAnalysis.result` and rendered in `src/pages/CareerPaths.jsx`.
- It is synthesized from approved CV versions; it does not directly edit SavedCV.

## Build / test commands
- Install deps: `npm install`
- Full local backend+frontend: `base44 dev`
- Frontend-only dev: `npm run dev`
- Lint: `npm run lint`
- Build: `npm run build`
- Type check: `npm run typecheck`
- Note: no stable `npm test` script is defined in `package.json`.

## Important project rules
- Keep Master CV and Tailored CV separate.
- CV Review Coach and Career Repositioning are read-only analysis paths; CV writing happens via assistant execution flow.
- Do not bypass RLS boundaries on user-owned entities.
- Keep workflows contextual: ATS/skill-gap inside Job Tailor; salary intelligence inside Suitable Jobs.
- Prefer minimal, surgical changes; avoid schema/agent/workflow rewrites unless explicitly requested.
- Follow project process: **INSPECT → TRACE → REPORT → APPROVE → IMPLEMENT → VERIFY → REPORT**.
